steps.name: 测试SSHManager初始化
steps.description: 测试SSH管理器的跳板机连接功能
steps.command:
cd /mnt/e/github/aiclouddeploy/gpu-cluster-deploy && python -c "

jumphost_config = {
    'host': '36.103.234.31',
    'port': 22,
    'username': 'ubuntu',
    'password': 'BDZ2.7YbtEwJfDRi'
}

result = manager.connect_jumphost(timeout=30)

steps.name: 测试通过跳板机连接目标服务器
steps.description: 测试SSHManager的get_connection方法，连接到内网服务器
steps.command:
cd /mnt/e/github/aiclouddeploy/gpu-cluster-deploy && python -c "
from src.ssh_manager import SSHManager
jumphost_config = {
    'host': '36.103.234.31',
    'port': 22,
    'username': 'ubuntu',
    'password': 'BDZ2.7YbtEwJfDRi'
}
manager = SSHManager(jumphost_config)
manager.connect_jumphost(timeout=30)
conn = manager.get_connection(host='10.0.18.87', username='ubuntu', password='BDZ2.7YbtEwJfDRi', timeout=30)
if conn:
    result = conn.execute('hostname && echo Connection OK')
    print(f'Target connection: SUCCESS')
    print(f'Output: {result.stdout.strip()}')
    manager.close_all()
else:
    print('Target connection: FAILED')
"

steps.name: 测试批量命令执行
steps.description: 测试在多个目标服务器上批量执行命令
steps.command:
cd /mnt/e/github/aiclouddeploy/gpu-cluster-deploy && python -c "
from src.ssh_manager import SSHManager
jumphost_config = {
    'host': '36.103.234.31',
    'port': 22,
    'username': 'ubuntu',
    'password': 'BDZ2.7YbtEwJfDRi'
}
manager = SSHManager(jumphost_config)
manager.connect_jumphost(timeout=30)
results = manager.execute_on_hosts(
    hosts=['10.0.18.87', '10.0.19.134'],
    command='hostname && uptime',
    username='ubuntu',
    password='BDZ2.7YbtEwJfDRi',  # Note: second server has different password
    timeout=60
)
for host, result in results.items():
    print(f'{host}: {\"SUCCESS\" if result.success else \"FAILED\"} - {result.stdout.strip()[:50]}')
manager.close_all()
"

steps.name: 检测GPU设备
steps.description: 在目标服务器上检测GPU设备是否存在
steps.command:
cd /mnt/e/github/aiclouddeploy/gpu-cluster-deploy && python -c "
from src.ssh_manager import SSHManager
jumphost_config = {
    'host': '36.103.234.31',
    'port': 22,
    'username': 'ubuntu',
    'password': 'BDZ2.7YbtEwJfDRi'
}
manager = SSHManager(jumphost_config)
manager.connect_jumphost(timeout=30)
conn = manager.get_connection(host='10.0.18.87', username='ubuntu', password='BDZ2.7YbtEwJfDRi', timeout=30)
if conn:
    result = conn.execute('lspci | grep -i nvidia || echo No NVIDIA GPU found')
    print(f'GPU Detection:\n{result.stdout}')
    manager.close_all()
"
